concerns.text: Task T030c mandates a paired t‑test between Random Forest predictions and a DummyRegressor (Mean Predictor) which outputs a constant value for all samples. A paired t‑test assumes paired, independent observations with variability; comparing a variable series to a constant series violates these assumptions, making the test statistically invalid. Consequently, the task cannot satisfy Success Criterion SC‑002 (statistically significant improvement via paired t‑test or Wilcoxon fallback) as specified in the spec. The methodology must be revised (e.g., use a more appropriate baseline model with variability or adjust the statistical test) to ensure the requirement can be met.
